rates.name: Final Value Fee - Most Categories
rates.notes: 13.25% on total amount of sale up to $7,500 per item; 2.35% on the portion over $7,500

rates.name: Final Value Fee - Store Subscriber (Most Categories)
rates.notes: 12.35% on total amount of sale up to $7,500 per item for Basic and higher Store subscribers; 2.35% on the portion over $7,500

rates.name: Final Value Fee - Books, Movies & Music
rates.notes: 15.3% on total amount of sale up to $7,500 (14.95% for Store subscribers); 2.35% on portion over $7,500

rates.name: Final Value Fee - Computers & Electronics (Store)
rates.notes: 9.35% on total amount of sale up to $2,500 for Store subscribers (13.25% non-store); 2.35% on portion over $2,500

rates.name: Final Value Fee - Guitars & Musical Instruments
rates.notes: 6.7% on total amount of sale up to $7,500 (6.35% for Store subscribers); 2.35% on portion over $7,500

rates.name: Final Value Fee - Jewelry & Watches
rates.notes: 15.0% on total amount of sale up to $5,000 (13.0% for Store subscribers); 9.0% on portion over $5,000

rates.name: Final Value Fee - Athletic Shoes & Sneakers ($150+)
rates.notes: 8.0% for Men's and Women's Athletic Shoes sold at $150 or more; fixed per-order fee is waived

rates.name: Final Value Fee - Heavy Equipment & Commercial
rates.notes: 3.0% on total amount of sale up to $15,000 (2.5% for Store subscribers); 0.5% on portion over $15,000

rates.name: Per-Order Fee (Orders over $10.00)
rates.notes: Fixed $0.40 per order when total buyer payment exceeds $10.00

rates.name: Per-Order Fee (Orders $10.00 or less)
rates.notes: Fixed $0.30 per order when total buyer payment is $10.00 or less

rates.name: Top Rated Plus Discount
rates.notes: 10% discount applied to the Final Value Fee percentage portion on qualifying Top Rated Plus listings

notes: Official eBay US selling fee schedule. Final value fee applies to the total amount of the sale, which includes item price and shipping charged to the buyer. Fixed per-order fee is $0.30 for orders $10.00 or less and $0.40 for orders over $10.00.
